task.title: How to install ExpressVPN?
task.shortdesc: This is about tasks to install ExpressVPN.

ol.li: Ensure that the installation of any app is not blocked by system administrator.
Ensure that the antivirus software is turned off so that the VPN can be installed.

step.cmd: Download the expressvpn.exe file from the and troubleshoot using
Install the file by clicking Run as administrator..
step.stepresult: When the VPN is installed, the user will see a screen asking for username, password and token.
step.steptroubleshooting: If the user, sees the message The app is blocked by your administratordisable the antivirus software and restart both the laptop and the router.

step.cmd: Enter the username and the password.

info.note: The username and password are provided by the IT administrator.You must see that the password length should not be less than 10 characters.

step.cmd: After entering username and pasword, check the email ID to get the token.
step.steptroubleshooting: Raise the helpdesk ticket to get the token if you have not received it.

step.cmd: Click the Connect button after entering all the details.

info.note: Leave all the settings as they are on the Settings page.

step.stepresult: When the VPN is installed and active, you will see a small icon in the system tray. You can also see the icon in the Start menu.
